steps.message:
`routes/users.js:6` is the only place `userId` appears — a one-line change. But it's a response field name on `GET /users`, so the consequence lands outside the line I'd touch.

`README.md` states the contract explicitly:

> Consumers of `GET /users`: the web app, the iOS app (3.2 and later), and the nightly partner export. Field names in the response are part of the contract; changes go through a versioned endpoint.

Renaming in place breaks all three consumers at once — the iOS app worst, since shipped 3.2+ clients can't be updated in step, and the nightly partner export fails outside your control. The consistency argument is real (`/orders` already returns `order_id`/`user_id`), but the README's stated remedy for exactly this is a versioned endpoint, not an in-place rename.

I haven't changed anything yet.
